name: Filia Regis
source:
This is a short demo for an ongoing furry pixel visual novel made in Ren'Py about the post-revolution state of a deposed evil queen.

[From [url=https://prettyflowerdog.itch.io/filia-regis]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是在Ren'Py中制作的一部毛茸茸的像素视觉小说的简短演示，讲述了被废黜的邪恶女王的革命后状态。

[来自[url=https://prettyflowerdog.itch.io/filia-regis]Itch.io[/url]]
